notes: Portable C++ and Java translation of the mapped native three-member ordinary-boundary-before-FQR timed-save case. The adapter supplies provider, FOM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time implementation. With HLA_EVOKED callbacks, a regulating owner requests a save at time 5, a constrained FQR member requests time 6, and a constrained ordinary TAR member requests the inclusive save boundary 5. The ordinary member receives Initiate Federate Save before grant 5 while the FQR member remains unserviced; the FQR member subsequently receives save initiation before actual Flush Queue Grant(6), and all three members complete the save. Direct traceability is limited to five pinned requirement-section pairs in clauses 4.19, 4.19.6, and 4.20. C++ primary and contract passed against an installed package under integer64 and float64 time. Java compiles against the official API only; provider runtime is unverified. No private-registry, universal cross-service ordering, immediate-callback, transport, interoperability, or conformance claim.
